# use-email

Expanded LLM context for the RustUse email facade.

- Canonical facade crate page: https://rustuse.org/use-email/

- Full RustUse context: https://rustuse.org/llms-full.txt

## Routing notes

The canonical short routes are https://rustuse.org/use-email/llms.txt and https://rustuse.org/use-email/llms-full.txt. The /facades/use-email/ routes serve this exact generated content so the two paths cannot drift.
